_readme: All GLBs: Y-up, base at y=0, normalised by Tripo so the largest extent is 1.0 (see bindBBox). Scale = heightM / bindHeight. Only EXT_texture_webp (+ KHR_mesh_quantization for market_stall) is required: plain THREE.GLTFLoader, no meshopt/draco decoder. Tripo meshes are dressing only, never colliders or geography. Provenance in /ASSETS.md.

ranger.skeleton: Mixamo humanoid, 66 joints mixamorig:*, root node Armature
ranger.notes: T-pose bind (x span = arms). Stay-in-place clips. 'climb' is a ONE-SHOT ledge pull-up: Hips rise from 0.33 to 1.19 (bind units), so play once (LoopOnce, clampWhenFinished), then move the object up by 0.81*scale and crossfade to idle. 'run' Hips X/Z were zeroed to bind (Tripo baked a +0.40 forward offset). 'chop' = two-handed overhead swing; the rock hammer in the mesh is holstered at the right hip, so parent a small procedural hammer to mixamorig:RightHand while chopping. 'play_mobile_game' (head down, hands at chest) reads as writing in the notebook; optionally parent a small notebook to mixamorig:LeftHand. 'frustrated_01' for a far pin.

ibex.skeleton: Tripo quadruped ('Other') auto-rig, 35 joints, root joint tripo::Root under node Armature

proceduralRoles.idle: walk clip paused at t=0 (weight 1, timeScale 0) + procedural breathing (Spine_1 scale/rotation) and slow head look (tripo::Head_1 yaw +-0.3 rad)
proceduralRoles.run: walk clip at timeScale 2.0-2.4 + small vertical bob
proceduralRoles.leap: walk clip at timeScale 2.5 + parabolic root arc in code (0.6-1.0 m high), tuck legs by rotating tripo::0_*_Limb_1 / tripo::1_*_Limb_1
proceduralRoles.taunt: walk paused + fast head shake: tripo::Head_1 yaw sin(t*18)*0.35 for 0.8 s, then a little hop; pair with a bleat/laugh sound
proceduralRoles.sulk: walk paused + lower the body (object y -0.25*scale), pitch tripo::Head_0/Head_1 down ~0.5 rad, fold legs by bending Limb_1/Limb_2; a short 'hmph' puff

ibex.notes: Tripo only offers a quadruped Walk preset; its AI animation and multi-stage motion are humanoid-only, so idle/leap/taunt/sulk are procedural on this skeleton. The head looks toward +Z but the BODY is yawed ~33 deg toward -X (front feet mid (0.02, 0.06), hind feet mid (0.25, -0.30)): set rotation.y = yawOffsetRad (+0.57) so the walk travels along +Z. Height 1.0 bind units includes horns. Coat is bright golden-orange; tint material.color toward #E8C48A if it reads too orange.

acacia.notes: NEW. Umbrella acacia (Arava/Eilat): twisted trunk, flat-ish green crown with yellow puffballs. Canopy wider along X.

date_palm.notes: NEW. Two leaning date palms with orange date bunches (Dead Sea / Ein Gedi / Kinneret oasis). Asked for three, got two.

basalt_boulders.notes: NEW. Cluster of 4-5 rounded charcoal/blue-grey vesicular basalt boulders with lichen dots and two yellow grass tufts. Golan / Kinneret hammer target; scale 0.8-2.5 m and rotate for variety.

lookout_tower.notes: NEW. Wooden nature-reserve lookout: four braced legs, zig-zag stair, roofed platform with green flag and brass binoculars, low stone base. Platform floor at about 0.55 bind height (≈4.4 m at 8 m) — check in scene. The one climbable lookout per postcard.

church_tower.notes: NEW. Honey-yellow limestone bell tower, bronze bell in the belfry, mint-green spire + cross, red arched door facing +Z. Rather saturated yellow; tint toward #EBDDBF for cream limestone if needed.

minaret.notes: NEW. Slender stone minaret: square base with arched door (+Z), octagonal shaft, balcony, green cone dome with gold crescent. Tripo painted the shaft lavender; the base-colour texture was recoloured to cream limestone and strong blue to teal (see ASSETS.md).

olive.notes: REUSED (ph-rangers via rift-makers). Gnarled olive for Judean terraces.

cypress.notes: REUSED (ph-rangers via rift-makers). Mediterranean cypress, instancing-friendly (4.8k tris).

fan_palm.notes: REUSED (halfpipe-joule). Washingtonia fan palm: Tel Aviv promenade / global street. Not a date palm.

rocks.notes: REUSED (ph-rangers via rift-makers). Cream limestone boulder cluster. Tint material.color: kurkar #D9925A, red granite #C0645A, chalk #F2EEE2; keep basalt to basalt_boulders.

terrace_wall.notes: REUSED (ph-rangers wall-high, dequantized). Square dry-stone limestone panel; squash Y to ~0.5 and tile along X for Judean terraces; also usable as a Nabatean check-dam course (tint ochre).

field_wall.notes: REUSED (ph-rangers wall, dequantized). Long low dry-stone wall, long axis X. Tint dark grey #4A4644 for Golan basalt field walls.

house.notes: REUSED (ph-rangers via rift-makers). Cream limestone flat-roof stone house, turquoise door +Z. Jerusalem / Nazareth / Galilee.

market_stall.notes: REUSED (clumpus). Wooden stall, striped yellow/coral awning, crates of citrus and watermelons. Claymation-ish; fine for Nazareth old market. Uses KHR_mesh_quantization (core three.js support).
